whyChooseUs.title: Child-Centered
whyChooseUs.subtitle: Individualized Self-Directed Discovery
whyChooseUs.description: Every child is unique. Our authentic Montessori approach recognizes that infants and toddlers learn best through active, self-paced exploration with concrete sensorial materials rather than passive lecturing.

whyChooseUs.title: Safe & Nurturing
whyChooseUs.subtitle: A Peaceful Home Away From Home
whyChooseUs.description: A secure, child-proofed campus with 24/7 security gate monitoring, thorough classroom sanitation before 7:30 AM, loving supervision, and strict positive discipline with zero abusive corporal punishment.

whyChooseUs.title: Christian Values
whyChooseUs.subtitle: Presbyterian Faith, Love & Character
whyChooseUs.description: Firmly rooted in the Presbyterian Church of Ghana tradition. Daily morning devotions, prayer circles, scripture memory, and Christian morals nurture young hearts to love God, respect elders, and care for others.

whyChooseUs.title: Experienced Teachers
whyChooseUs.subtitle: Certified Montessori Guides & Caregivers
whyChooseUs.description: Warm, highly dedicated early childhood educators trained in authentic Montessori methods, infant hygiene, first aid, and responsive caregiving who guide each child with Christ-like patience and affection.

programs.name: Creche Community
programs.overview: A peaceful, hygienic, and loving haven in Bechem specifically designed for infants and early toddlers. Tender guidance promotes motor coordination, speech explosion, sensory exploration, and emotional security.

curriculumAreas.name: Practical Life & Self-Care

curriculumAreas.name: Emotional Security & Love
curriculumAreas.description: Unconditional warmth, responsive rocking, peaceful nap schedules in clean cots

schoolNotices.title: Admissions Open for the Upcoming Academic Year
schoolNotices.summary: Enrollment is now officially open for Creche and Day Care (Ages 4 Months to 4 Years).
schoolNotices.content: Good Shepherd Montessori School warmly invites parents and guardians in Bechem and surrounding communities to submit online or in-person admission applications. Due to our strictly maintained teacher-pupil ratios, classroom vacancies are allocated on a rolling first-come basis after preliminary assessment. Visit our administration block or apply online via our new portal.
schoolNotices.author: Admissions Office, Bechem Campus

schoolNotices.title: Term 1 Reopening & Morning Schedule Guidelines
schoolNotices.summary: School resumes promptly at 7:00 AM. Parents are reminded that drop-off is strictly between 7:00 AM and 7:30 AM.
schoolNotices.content: All continuing and fresh pupils are expected on campus by 7:30 AM for morning devotions. We remind all parents that the school does not offer transportation; kindly arrange safe family drop-off between 7:00 AM – 7:30 AM and prompt pick-up at 3:30 PM for our Creche and Day Care pupils.

schoolNotices.title: Annual PTA General Meeting & Executive Elections
schoolNotices.summary: All parents and guardians are invited to the Term 1 PTA General Assembly in the School Main Hall at 9:00 AM.
schoolNotices.content: Key agenda items include the review of campus infrastructure expansions, the review of academic progress reports, and the election of new parent representatives to the School Governing Council. Refreshments will be served.
schoolNotices.author: PTA Executive Committee

schoolNotices.title: Term Fee Payment & Instalment Arrangements
schoolNotices.summary: Parents are kindly urged to settle term fees through the approved GCB Bank, Ecobank, or MTN MoMo merchant channels.
schoolNotices.content: To ensure seamless teaching materials distribution and student catering, please make all payments into the official Good Shepherd Montessori School accounts. Submit the bank paying-in slip or MoMo reference text to the Bursar for an official receipt.
schoolNotices.author: Accounts & Bursar Department

schoolNotices.title: Healthy Snack & No-Junk-Food Policy Reminder
schoolNotices.summary: Promoting physical vitality and sound mental concentration through natural, wholesome school snacks.
schoolNotices.content: In line with our Montessori health and hygiene philosophy, carbonated fizzy drinks, artificial sugary confectionery, and instant noodles are not permitted in lunchboxes. We encourage fresh fruit, natural juices, and wholesome home-cooked snacks.
schoolNotices.author: School Health & Catering Unit

faqs.question: How do we apply for admission to Good Shepherd Montessori in Bechem?
faqs.answer: Admissions are open year-round with main intakes in September and January. Parents can collect an admission form from the school administration office in Bechem or fill out our online inquiry/tour booking form. After a brief friendly assessment of the child, the admission letter and prospectus are issued.

faqs.question: What does 'Growing in Faith and Love' mean in your daily school life?
faqs.answer: Our school combines authentic Montessori hands-on learning with strong Christian moral teachings. Children start the day with prayer and devotional songs, learn the golden rule of treating others with kindness, and are encouraged to cultivate honesty, respect for elders, and compassion for all.

faqs.question: Does your curriculum align with the Ghana Education Service (GES) standards?
faqs.answer: Yes, fully! We integrate the best of the international Montessori methodology (particularly in early childhood sensorial, reading, and mathematics) seamlessly with the GES National Curriculum guidelines, ensuring pupils are exceptionally prepared for high academic performance.

faqs.question: What are the school drop-off and pick-up hours?
faqs.answer: Parents bring their children in the morning between 7:00 AM and 7:30 AM for morning devotion. Pick-up is at the close of school at 3:30 PM for Creche and Day Care. Dedicated, safe visitor parking and organized gate security ensure safe and smooth transition every morning and afternoon.

faqs.question: Are payment plans available for school fees?
faqs.answer: Yes! We understand the economic needs of families. Fees can be paid termly, or parents can arrange a flexible installment plan through the bursar's office before the term examinations.

dropOffAndPickUp.title: Morning Drop-Off & Afternoon Pick-Up Protocols

morningDropOff.description: Gates open promptly at 7:00 AM. School morning assembly and devotions commence at 7:45 AM. Children should be dropped off on time to foster a peaceful transition into their classroom work cycle.

afternoonPickUp.description: Parents or designated guardians collect their wards directly at the campus dismissal stations. For student safety, children are only released to recognized parents or authorized guardians with the official School Pick-Up Security ID card.

safetyRules: No child will be released to an unauthorized adult without prior written or phone authorization from the parent to the administration office.
Parents are kindly asked to drive at 15 km/h or less within the school access lanes and use the designated visitor parking bays.
Prompt pick-up is encouraged to allow children adequate rest, home study, and evening family time.

packedLunchGuidelines.policy: Good Shepherd does not provide school meals. Parents provide wholesome home-packed breakfast, lunch packs, and snacks daily.
recommendedFoods: Warm home-cooked meals (Rice, Ampesi, Waakye, Yam) in insulated thermal flasks
Healthy protein sources (Boiled eggs, grilled fish, chicken, beans)
Fresh local fruits (Banana, pawpaw, watermelon slices, oranges)
Wholewheat bread, plain crackers, and wholesome morning snacks
prohibitedFoods: Carbonated fizzy soft drinks and artificial packaged sugary juices
Chewing gums, lollipops, artificial gummies, and heavily colored candies
Raw uncooked instant noodles or hazardous packaging
packedLunchGuidelines.hydration: Clean, durable, labeled reusable water flask with clean drinking water brought daily. Campus refill points available.

feePaymentChannels.instruction: Please use your Child's Full Name and Class as the deposit reference (e.g., 'Kofi Mensah - Creche'). Submit the duplicate deposit slip to the School Bursar.

feePaymentChannels.institution: Bechem Branch - Derma Community Bank PLC
feePaymentChannels.instruction: Quote the Student ID number or Child's Name on all electronic wire and mobile bank transfers.
Dial *170# -> Option 2 (MoMo Pay) -> Merchant ID: 482019. Enter Child's Name as reference. Send SMS confirmation to the Bursar.
Dial *110# -> Option 4 (Make Payment) -> Enter Merchant Number. Enter Child's Name as reference. Submit confirmation SMS to the school office.

ptaInfo.title: Parent-Teacher Association (PTA)
ptaInfo.schedule: General meetings are held once per term on a Saturday morning (9:00 AM – 11:30 AM).
ptaInfo.mission: Fostering active collaboration between parents and educators, supporting campus enrichment projects, and maintaining open dialogue for the holistic wellbeing of every child.

dayInLifeMoments.title: Parent Drop-off & Morning Devotion
dayInLifeMoments.description: Parents safely drop off their children at the school gates in Bechem. Every child is greeted with a warm smile and eye contact. We open the day lifting our voices in songs of praise and prayer.

dayInLifeMoments.title: Uninterrupted Montessori Work Cycle
dayInLifeMoments.description: No loud bells or rushing. Pupils independently select work mats, roll out their activities, and focus deeply with self-correcting wooden materials.

dayInLifeMoments.title: Practical Life, Snack & Cleanliness
dayInLifeMoments.description: Children wash hands at the water stand, serve their meals, clean tables with small sponges, and return utensils to their designated places.

dayInLifeMoments.title: Peer-to-Peer Mentorship
dayInLifeMoments.description: An older KG2 child guides a nursery friend on how to arrange the Pink Tower cubes from largest to smallest, reinforcing patience and love.

dayInLifeMoments.title: Closing Prayer & Safe Parent Pick-Up
dayInLifeMoments.description: After an afternoon of creative arts, sensory exploration, and play, the school day concludes with a peaceful closing prayer. Parents and authorized guardians arrive for a secure, orderly pick-up.
